title: DIY modder creates 'heat engine computing device' powered by a Stirling engine, can run Tetris, Snake, and Pong 80 MHz processor operates on just 150 milliwatts of power
summary: A DIY modder created a Stirling engine-powered gaming device that runs classic games like Tetris, Snake, and Pong on an 80 MHz processor, all while operating on just 150 milliwatts of power.
insight: Revolutionizing energy-efficient computing with innovative thermal energy harvesting.

title: Windows 11's built-in weather app hogs more than 1.2 gigabytes of RAM just to tell the forecast memory-sucking web wrapper filled with ads masquerades as an actual application

insight: Resource-intensive design prioritizes advertising over user experience and efficiency.

title: PewCB One Desktop PCB fabrication system enables rapid prototyping at home
summary: PewCB One allows users to quickly manufacture PCBs at home, accelerating hardware development through a fully enclosed laser engraver system. This system utilizes laser ablation to create traces as low as 0.1mm, and can handle double-sided PCB blanks with vias and plated through-holes. The entire process can be completed at home, reducing wait times significantly.
insight: Accelerated hardware development through rapid at-home PCB manufacturing.

title: Makerfabs Nomad Terminal features ESP32-S3 WiSoC, LR1121 LoRa transceiver, 3.5-inch touchscreen display
summary: The Makerfabs Nomad Terminal is a handheld development platform that uses an ESP32-S3 MCU and Semtech LR1121 LoRa transceiver for long-range wireless communication, along with features like a 3.5-inch touchscreen display, 9-axis motion sensor, and 5,000 mAh rechargeable battery.
insight: Long-range wireless capabilities for IoT applications without cellular connectivity.

title: PyBLE open-source MicroPython IDE works over Bluetooth LE for tablet and iPad users
summary: PyBLE is an open-source MicroPython IDE for programming microcontrollers over Bluetooth LE, targeting Android tablet and iPad users. It combines a Flutter-based IDE with support for MicroPython, Blockly, and wireless file management. Initial firmware targets include ESP32, ESP32-S3, and ESP32-C3 wireless microcontrollers.
insight: Empowers Android tablet and iPad users to program microcontrollers wirelessly.
